programme.title: Kiko
programme.desc: Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang sangat mandiri, walaupun ia anak tunggal. Kiko selalu riang dan memiliki empat sahabat baik yaitu Lola si ikan diskus, Ting Ting si kepiting, Patino si ikan patin dan Poli si ikan cupang. Di sisi lain, sosok antagonis, Karkus si ikan lele dan Pupus si belut, selalu membuat ricuh kehidupan Kiko.

programme.title: Uang Kaget Lagi Dobel Kagetnya S1 E4

programme.title: The Intern S1 E1
programme.desc: Ini adalah hari pertama Beckham magang di platform e-commerce lokal, The F Thing. Kesalahpahaman antara koordinator pemotretan talent, M dan Fika, membuat Beckham terlambat menghadiri briefing magangnya dan malah menjadi model katalog.

programme.title: The Intern S1 E2
programme.desc: Para intern Beckham, Hazell, dan Zoe membantu proses syuting segmen profiling di majalah The F Thing. Ternyata profil yang disorot adalah bintang media sosial, Keyla, yang kebetulan merupakan mantan pacar Beckham saat SMA. Keyla mengira bahwa Beckham adalah bos di The F Thing. Hazell pun menjadi cemburu.

programme.title: The Intern S1 E3
programme.desc: Direktur pemasaran, Stella, kesal dengan Hazell dan M karena mengirim katalog yang salah kepada salah satu vendor utama mereka, Mrs. Judith. Namun, yang mengejutkan mereka, Mrs. Judith justru sangat senang dengan katalog yang menampilkan grafis Beckham sebagai model, dan menuntut agar gambar tersebut ditampilkan di papan iklan (billboard).

programme.title: The Intern S1 E4
programme.desc: Stella tidak puas dengan proposal kreatif Shawn belakangan ini, sehingga ia mulai beralih kepada Beckham dan menugaskannya untuk menghadiri pertemuan presentasi dengan klien. Selain itu, Beckham tampil sangat baik dalam merancang konsep ulang tahun tahunan The F Thing — yang membuat Stella mengundangnya ke acara makan malam penting bersama pemilik dan beberapa klien.

programme.title: The Intern S1 E5
programme.desc: Ironisnya, Beckham tidak bisa bermain sepak bola, tetapi ia dipaksa untuk bergabung dengan tim The F Thing dalam sebuah pertandingan. Beckham bertabrakan dengan seorang desainer fashion yang menarik, yang ternyata adalah vendor The F Thing, dan juga ternyata adalah pacar seseorang.

programme.title: Zak Storm

Zack dijadikan kapten kapal Chaos, sehingga mengharuskannya untuk bekerja sama dengan pedang ajaib yang bisa berbicara bernama Calabrass guna menghadapi berbagai bahaya di negeri tersebut.

programme.desc: Lala harus menghadapi seorang calon art director yang menjengkelkan, Jun. programme.title: CinLock S1 E4

programme.title: Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: Kisah luar biasa tentang seorang pendekar wanita kejam yang bertekad untuk menangkap pembunuh orangtuanya.

programme.desc: Raja Kera dan gengnya dihadang oleh Putri Kipas Besi yang jahat, Nyonya Tulang Putih dan dua adiknya yang seksi, serta sederet karakter-karakter aneh lainnya.

programme.title: Madam White Snake
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai memerankan tokoh Pak Su-cheng, dewi ular nan mempesona yang memilih wujud sebagai seorang wanita sehingga ia dapat merasakan indahnya kehidupan manusia!

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao dan Kuan Wang-lung bekerja sebagai penjaga di Tien Ying Treasury House, sebuah perusahaan yang menawarkan jasa penyimpanan dan transportasi yang aman bagi uang atau barang berharga milik para klien.

programme.title: Return Of The Phoenix
programme.desc: Return Of The Phoenix adalah karya besar lain dari sutradara Li Han-hsiang. Sebuah film komedi seputar peristiwa-peristiwa menjelang pernikahan putri sang perdana menteri.

programme.title: Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: Seorang bangsawan yang kehilangan keterampilan kung fu meminta keponakan dan tunangannya untuk mengawal emas ke ibukota. Di perjalanan, mereka bertemu seorang ksatria misterius dan mencegah para bandit mencuri emas.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: David jatuh cinta pada Dan Feng dan menikahinya. Saudari David yang bernama Mona jatuh cinta dengan sahabatnya, Han Ming. Karena cemburu, Mona berbohong tentang perselingkuhan antara Han Ming dan Dan Feng.

programme.title: Diary Of A Lady-Killer
programme.desc: Seorang pencinta wanita kaya menulis buku harian tentang petualangan asmaranya, tetapi semua wanita yang pernah diselingkuhinya telah dibunuh.

programme.title: All Men Are Brothers
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah patriotik tentang tujuh prajurit dalam kelompok penjahat 108 di Gunung Liang, serta tujuh pertempuran nan luar biasa melawan pejabat pemerintah yang kejam demi menyelamatkan negara mereka.

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: Setelah Kuil Shaolin dihancurkan, lima orang siswa belajar teknik-teknik Shaolin untuk mengalahkan musuh-musuh mereka yang dipimpin oleh Ching. Namun, ada seorang 'pengkhianat' di antara mereka. Siapakah ia?

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung yang hidup di Gunung Ular Kwangsi bersama dengan saudaranya, Ular Hitam dan Ular Kuning, telah berusaha untuk berubah menjadi manusia selama seribu tahun.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: Ti Lung yang hidup di Gunung Ular Kwangsi bersama dengan saudaranya, Ular Hitam dan Ular Kuning, telah berusaha untuk berubah menjadi manusia selama seribu tahun.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: Dunia seni bela diri akan kacau jika dua penjahat besar, Winged Tiger dan Underworld King bergabung. Hal ini akan terjadi dengan pernikahan antara saudara perempuan dari Underworld King dan Winged Tiger.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: Sekuel dari The Empress Dowager ini melanjutkan kisah Kaisar Guangxu dan Ibu Suri Cixi. Terlepas dari penobatan Guangxu sebagai raja, kemampuannya untuk memerintah secara efektif dibayangi oleh kekuatan Cixi.

programme.title: Vengeance Is A Golden Blade
programme.desc: Istri Pengiring Master Li berselingkuh dengan saingannya yang bernama Long, ia berencana untuk mencuri Pedang Emas Li dan membunuhnya serta putrinya yang masih kecil.

programme.title: Song Of Orchid Island
programme.desc: Paul Chang Chung berperan sebagai Dr. Ho yang memutuskan untuk pindah ke sebuah pulau terpencil di lepas pantai Taiwan untuk mencari ayahnya yang hilang.

programme.title: Kid From Kwangtung
programme.desc: Keluarga seorang pemimpin Anti-Ching yang dibunuh kabur ke kota kecil yang dihuni oleh para pelajar yang saling bersaing dan sejumlah pelatih olahraga yang tangguh. Namun, salah satu guru ternyata adalah agen rahasia.

programme.title: The Younger Generation
programme.desc: Sebuah kisah tragis tentang seorang gadis yang menikah dan memiliki 5 anak. Setelah ia dan sang suami meninggal, salah seorang anaknya terpaksa menjadi PSK untuk menafkahi keempat saudaranya.

programme.title: Rape Of The Sword
programme.desc: Li Li-hua berperan sebagai seorang wanita pendekar pedang yang berusaha untuk merebut kembali 'Pedang Hijau', pedang paling tajam di dunia, milik suaminya yang tewas dibunuh.

programme.title: Swordsman At Large
programme.desc: Para bandit, gadis cantik dan ahli pedang bertarung untuk bertahan hidup dalam kisah menarik tentang penipuan, pengkhianatan dan kematian ini.

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: Penduduk Kota Liu terpaksa melarikan diri saat geng Macan Hitam yang kejam menyerang kota. Namun, para penduduk berhasil menyembunyikan semua emas dan harta mereka di sebuah lembah.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Lo Wei mengarahkan film romantis yang menampilkan bakat akting Ivy Ling Po nan luar biasa. Film ini bercerita tentang seorang sarjana muda yang diperdaya untuk menikahi seorang putri bangsawan.

programme.title: Danger Has Two Faces
programme.desc: Bertahun-tahun yang lalu, Inspektur Kam membunuh seorang pria tak bersalah dan mengundurkan diri dari kepolisian. Kini, ia menjadi pembunuh profesional yang menyamar sebagai pemilik toko hewan peliharaan.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan dan muridnya Fan bekerja mengangkut zombie. Saat mereka berdua melarikan diri, ternyata salah satu dari mereka sebenarnya adalah seorang pria yang sedang menyamar dan kabur dari musuh-musuhnya.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: Pendekar pedang Chin Wu-hsin ditugaskan untuk menemukan Pedang Agung milik Elang Tua, namun ia melakukan cara-cara curang untuk mendapatkannya. Kejadian ini menuntun putra Elang Tua untuk membalaskan dendam sang ayah.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: Sekelompok ahli bela diri yang menganggur mengalami nasib buruk.

programme.title: Get In The Dark
programme.desc: Nona Qiao meninggal secara tak wajar dan kepala pelayannya membayar seorang perajin untuk membuat sebuah boneka kertas. Serangkaian peristiwa nan mengerikan terjadi saat arwah Nona Qiao bangkit untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Young Heroes Of Chaotic Times
programme.desc: Kisah ini berlatar di Shanghai pada akhir masa Dinasti Qing, dan bercerita tentang seorang pemuda bernama Chen Zhen yang menjadi seorang pahlawan nasional usai menanggung kesulitan dan mengatasi tantangan dalam hidup.

programme.title: How To Choose A Royal Bride
programme.desc: Kaisar muda Kangxi sedang berusaha memilih seorang istri. Ibunya telah mengatur agar beberapa wanita muda yang tersedia mengunjunginya sehingga ia dapat memilih.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: Klan Black Feather nan jahat menyusup ke wilayah Master Fire Cloud dan mencuri Topeng Shura, sehingga melepaskan roh jahat nan masih bayi. Namun, Master Fire Cloud mengadopsi bayi itu untuk mencegahnya menjadi jahat.

programme.title: Out Of The Dark
programme.desc: Seorang wanita tua tewas setelah terjatuh dari sebuah gedung dan arwahnya menghantui tempat tersebut. Merasa ketakutan, para penjaga keamanan setempat pun meminta bantuan Leo si pemburu hantu beserta asistennya.

programme.title: Gangster, The Cop, The Devil
programme.desc: Detektif Lin membentuk unit khusus untuk menangkap perampok motor dan sindikat di balik aksi pencurian di Foshan usai istrinya yang hamil ditabrak oleh perampok motor.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi akan mewarisi kekayaan kakeknya yang tengah sekarat dengan satu syarat, yaitu ia harus menikah dalam waktu sebulan. Jika tidak, warisan tersebut akan diberikan kepada sang paman yang bernama Robert.

programme.title: Destiny's Champion
programme.desc: Sun Chung dan Ti Lung bersatu kembali untuk sebuah kisah menegangkan tentang seorang pendekar tua yang berusaha menebus kesalahannya di masa lalu melalui seorang anak jalanan yang bijaksana.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: Seorang pemimpin tim SWAT dipaksa oleh kaptennya untuk menyamar sebagai siswa SMA guna mengambil kembali senjata pribadi kapten yang dicuri selama kunjungan lapangan sekolah ke kantor polisi.

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: Film ini bercerita tentang seorang imigran gelap asal Tiongkok, Cheung Kwan-chow, dan perjalanannya di New York.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: Kepala keluarga kaya meninggal dunia dan dalam wasiatnya mewariskan kekayaannya kepada putrinya. Putranya marah dan menggunakan seorang pengumpul sampah yang mirip dengan saudara perempuannya untuk mencuri kekayaan tersebut. Putra paman juga menginginkan bagian dari kekayaan itu dan memaksa seorang pencuri kecil untuk mencuri wasiat tersebut demi rencana jahatnya.

programme.title: The Lost Bladesman
programme.desc: Petualangan bersejarah nan epik berlatar masa-masa penuh gejolak di masa Tiga Kerajaan. Cao Cao berusaha untuk memasukkan Guan Yu ke dalam pasukannya, tapi Guan tetap setia pada Liu Bei, yang merupakan musuh Cao.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: Seorang penulis yang putus asa menjalin persahabatan yang tidak terduga dengan seorang remaja dari Long Island.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell
programme.desc: Raja Naga dikunci dalam segel oleh Tuan Naga selama 500 tahun, dan putri sang Raja harus kembali ke masa lalu guna membunuh Tuan Naga saat mengetahui bahwa keduanya adalah teman dekat di masa lalu.

programme.title: Dragon Master: Dragon Spell

Seorang Pendeta Tao dan dua muridnya berusaha menghentikan teror tersebut.

programme.title: The Railway Children Return
programme.desc: Ikuti sekelompok anak-anak yang dievakuasi ke desa Yorkshire selama Perang Dunia Kedua, di mana mereka bertemu dengan seorang prajurit muda yang, seperti mereka, jauh dari rumah.

programme.desc: Mengabadikan perjalanan Megan Thee Stallion menuju ketenaran, mengarungi ketenaran, duka, dan kesuksesan. Film ini menawarkan akses tak tertandingi kepada sang seniman multifaset, mengungkap momen-momen rentannya, dan memungkinkan kita bertemu dengan Megan Pete yang sesungguhnya di balik persona tersebut.

programme.title: The Crime Is Mine
programme.desc: Paris, Prancis, 1935, dan seorang aktris muda baru saja dibebaskan dari tuduhan pembunuhan seorang produser terkenal Prancis. Namun, di sinilah kisahnya baru dimulai. Apakah ia benar-benar tidak bersalah? Atau ia lolos dari pembunuhan?

programme.title: My Stepdaughter
programme.desc: Casey berusaha memecah hubungan antara ayahnya dan istri barunya, Jill, tepat ketika ibu Jill tiba-tiba meninggal dunia. Saat Jill mulai mengungkap berbagai petunjuk, ia menyadari bahwa anak tirinya mungkin sedang memainkan permainan berbahaya yang bisa mengancam nyawanya.

programme.title: Peter Bell 2: The Czar Crown
programme.desc: Pietje Bell dituduh mencuri jam dan dipenjara, lalu kabur membuktikan dirinya tak bersalah. Ia melawan penjahat Stark dan menggagalkan rencana pencurian mahkota bersama gengnya.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: Seorang penderita hipokondria yang bekerja sebagai petugas penanganan bagasi bandara terpaksa menghadapi ketakutannya ketika seorang remaja Inggris yang menderita penyakit mematikan memintanya untuk membantunya mewujudkan daftar keinginan anehnya.

programme.title: Full Out 2: You Got This!
programme.desc: Ketika tim Sooners dari University of Oklahoma kehilangan pesenam bintang mereka, Brenna Dowell, seluruh tim harus menemukan cara untuk percaya diri agar dapat memenangkan Kejuaraan Senam Nasional kedua mereka. Dengan bantuan Riley, seorang breakdance fenomenal lokal, Chayse dan rekan-rekan satu timnya dari OU belajar menggabungkan teknik breakdance yang rumit ke dalam rutinitas senam mereka untuk menemukan keunggulan kompetitif. Pada akhirnya, mereka menyadari bahwa yang terpenting adalah menemukan kepercayaan diri untuk percaya pada diri sendiri.

programme.title: Christmas Ranch
programme.desc: Saat kembali ke peternakan sang kakek menjelang Natal, seorang gadis remaja mengetahui bahwa usaha keluarga sedang menghadapi kesulitan yang mengancam masa depannya. Bertekad mempertahankan warisan tersebut, ia bekerja sama dengan keluarga sambil menghadapi berbagai tantangan dan mempererat kembali hubungan yang sempat merenggang. Dengan latar pedesaan yang hangat, kisah persahabatan dengan kuda, serta semangat kebersamaan di musim Natal, Christmas Ranch menyuguhkan drama keluarga yang penuh inspirasi tentang harapan, ketekunan, dan arti sebuah rumah.

programme.title: Nightmare Alley: Possession

programme.title: Stonehenge Apocalypse
programme.desc: Ketika sekelompok arkeolog menggali kerangka manusia di dekat Stonehenge, sebuah mesin kuno pun ditemukan. Para pekerja secara tidak sengaja memicu mekanisme tersebut dan memicu serangkaian peristiwa yang berpotensi menghancurkan dunia.

programme.title: Christmas Jars
programme.desc: Christmas Jars mengisahkan Hope Jensen, seorang jurnalis muda yang mengalami pencurian menjelang Natal. Tidak lama kemudian, ia menerima sebuah toples berisi uang dari seseorang yang tidak dikenal sebagai bentuk bantuan. Karena penasaran, Hope mulai menyelidiki siapa di balik hadiah tersebut dan menemukan tradisi unik bernama Christmas Jars, yaitu gerakan mengumpulkan uang untuk membantu orang-orang yang membutuhkan secara diam-diam. Dalam pencariannya, ia menemukan banyak kisah tentang kebaikan, kepedulian, dan makna sebenarnya dari semangat Natal.

programme.title: Outrage
programme.desc: Perintah seorang pemimpin yakuza untuk mempererat hubungan dengan kelompok rival justru memicu konflik yang semakin membesar. Otomo, seorang eksekutor berpengalaman, harus bertahan di tengah intrik, pengkhianatan, dan pertumpahan darah ketika setiap faksi berusaha memperluas pengaruhnya. Dengan atmosfer yang tegang dan penuh aksi, Outrage menyuguhkan thriller kriminal yang mengupas ambisi, loyalitas, serta kerasnya kehidupan di balik dunia organisasi kejahatan Jepang.

programme.title: Faith Heist
programme.desc: Ketika seorang pendeta karismatik mendapati gerejanya mengalami kehancuran finansial setelah ditipu oleh seorang penasihat keuangan yang licik, ia mengumpulkan anggota jemaatnya untuk melakukan perampokan guna mendapatkan kembali uang mereka dan menyelamatkan gereja sebelum terlambat.

programme.title: Holy Business
programme.desc: Dua bersaudara mewarisi sebuah mobil tua yang konon milik Uskup Karol Wojtyla, yang lebih dikenal sebagai Yohanes Paulus II. Mobil itu segera dianggap sebagai mukjizat, dan keduanya menganggapnya sebagai kesempatan untuk kehidupan yang lebih baik.

programme.title: A Boy Called Po
programme.desc: A Boy Called Po mengisahkan David Wilson, seorang ayah yang harus membesarkan putranya Patrick, atau yang biasa dipanggil Po, setelah istrinya meninggal dunia. Po adalah seorang anak dengan spektrum autisme yang memiliki cara unik dalam melihat dan memahami dunia di sekitarnya. Di tengah kesedihan, tekanan hidup, dan tantangan sebagai orang tua tunggal, David berusaha memberikan yang terbaik untuk putranya. Perjalanan mereka mengajarkan arti kasih sayang, penerimaan, kesabaran, dan kekuatan hubungan antara ayah dan anak.

programme.title: Carnera: The Walking Mountain
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kehidupan Primo Carnera, yang dikenal dengan julukan "Ambling Alp", seorang petinju profesional asal Italia yang menjadi Juara Dunia Kelas Berat dari Juni 1933 hingga Juni 1934. Namun, ia juga dituduh oleh sejumlah pihak memiliki hubungan dengan kelompok mafia.

programme.title: Death Squad
programme.desc: Ketika semua jalur komunikasi terputus dengan sebuah fasilitas penelitian ilmiah rahasia yang berlokasi di bekas laboratorium biokimia Uni Soviet, sebuah perusahaan militer swasta dibentuk untuk memasuki fasilitas tersebut guna mencari dan mengevakuasi dokter kepala.

programme.title: Yamada Samurai Of Ayothaya
programme.desc: Berdasarkan tokoh sejarah nyata pada masa Kerajaan Ayutthaya, film ini mengisahkan kehidupan Yamada Nagamasa, seorang petualang asal Jepang yang memperoleh pengaruh yang cukup besar di Thailand dan menjadi gubernur provinsi Nakhon Si Thammarat di Thailand selatan.

programme.desc: A high school kid embarks on a madcap adventure in Europe to find his online love.

programme.title: SNAKES ON A PLANE
programme.desc: Samuel L. Jackson is FBI Agent Neville Flynn and has to protect a crime witness from hundreds of snakes in mid-flight!

programme.title: WIFELIKE
programme.desc: Designed to behave like the late wife of a detective, an artificial human questions her reality as memories of a past life begin to resurface.

programme.title: MAVERICK
programme.desc: Maverick joins forces with a lady gambler to enter a Winner-Takes-All poker game.

programme.title: HOLLYWOOD ON SET S1
programme.desc: Each week Hollywood On Set goes behind-the-scenes on three major movies in production, featuring action footage and interviews with filmmakers.

programme.title: PU-239
programme.desc: A worker at a Russian nuclear plant steals a small amount of weapons grade plutonium and tries to sell it on the Moscow black market.
In the summer of 1961, two baseball players and best friends compete to beat the home run record set by legendary Babe Ruth in 1927.

programme.title: THE TRUMAN SHOW
programme.desc: Truman Burbank is the star of his own TV show and the town he has lived in all his life is really a soundstage! Stars Jim Carrey.

programme.title: JOKER
programme.desc: Arthur Fleck, aka the Joker, arch-nemesis of Batman, goes on his journey from societal outcast and failed comedian to cackling criminal mastermind.

programme.title: Si Paling Renang Cintanya Banyak Gaya
programme.desc: Seorang gadis cantik bernama Dinda (Shanice Margaretha) yang merupakan seorang atlet renang. Dinda yang akan mengikuti turnamen renang, harus masuk asrama untuk meningkatkan kemampuan renangnya. Di tempat tersebut, Dinda bertemu dengan Jordi (Fauzan Nasrul) yang merupakan atlet renang juga. Jordi yang tampan, banyak disukai para wanita. Kemudian, banyak kejadian yang semakin mendekatkan Dinda dan Jordi hingga tanpa mereka sadari, mereka berdua saling jatuh cinta. Masalah datang ketika sahabat dekat Dinda yang bernama Nisa, menyukai Jordi. Ia meminta agar Dinda mau mendekatkan Jordi kepadanya. Namun, Jordi tidak mau menerima cinta Nisa meski dipaksa Dinda karena Jordi sudah menyukai Dinda.

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Kita Usahakan Bobol Rumah Itu
programme.desc: Demi bayar sks jadi pacar Ian!! Bella harus terima perjanjian agar masih bisa kuliah. Karjo ayah Bella kehilangan pekerjaan!! dia frustasi harus cari uang kemana lagi buat menghidupi keluarganya. Ide cemerlang datang dari Akmal adik Bella!! dia memberikan ide agar merampok rumah orang kaya tapi sayangnya mereka salah sasaran!! rumah yang dirampok mereka adalah rumah Ian si anak orang kaya. Apakah ian akan tau bahwa yang merampok rumahnya adalah keluarga bella?.

programme.title: Tour Guide Penggaet Hati
programme.desc: Zahra bekerja di travel milik pacarnya Bima, dibantu sahabat Oliv. Dia bertemu Jaka (yang pindah ke Bontang untuk urus resort oma Lisa dan deket pacarnya Erin) saat koper Jaka menyakitkan kakinya, mulai perselisihan. Setelah Zahra telat membuat client batal, Bima marah, sedangkan mamanya Widia minta dia putus. Amanda (sahabat Zahra) yang akan menikah minta Zahra cari resort, ternyata Jaka juga menawari resort oma. Mereka terpaksa kerjasama dengan syarat Jaka ikut semua urusan, hingga terjebak di laut dan Jaka mulai melihat kebaikan Zahra. Erin dan Bima ternyata selingkuh dan rencanakan merusak Jaka.

Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Kukira Kau Rumah Kosong
programme.desc: Kedua orang pemuda tampan bernama Niko dan Adit. Dua orang pemuda tersebut yang merupakan mahasiswa, bekerja di bengkel motor dan pelayan restoran, tapi mereka berlagak menjadi orang kaya. Niko dan Adit menyukai dua gadis bernama Fifi dan Rara, tapi pada pria tersebut berpura-pura menjadi orang kaya agar gadis impian mereka jatuh cinta. Masalah menjadi rumit saat kedua pria itu mengetahui bahwa Jaya memiliki seorang putri bernama Karina.

programme.title: Ketika Rela Tak Semudah Kata
programme.desc: Sambil menunggu panggilan kerja, Yudha yang tidak ingin ibunya tahu kalau ia telah kehilangan pekerjaannya, terpaksa menjadi pengamen. Meski demikian, Sheila terus menyemangatinya hingga Yudha merasa nyaman bersama Sheila. Di sisi lain, Yudha memiliki Siska, sahabat yang menyukai Yudha. Yudha pun dihadapkan dua pilihan antara Sheila dan Siska.

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu

programme.title: Jalan Cinta Cindy
programme.desc: Cindy (Rayna Snova) janjian dengan kekasihnya yang bernama Rama di sebuah restoran. Cindy berpikir di tempat romantis tersebut Rama akan melamarnya. Namun, harapan Cindy sirna saat mengetahui bahwa Rama mengajaknya bertemu karena Rama ingin memutuskan hubungan cintanya dengan Cindy. Mengetahui hal tersebut, hati Cindy sangat hancur. Ia pun termenung di tempat tersebut sambil memikirkan nasib hidupnya yang penuh kesedihan. Lalu, Cindy merasa ada seseorang yang sedang memotret dirinya. Ia pun marah kepada fotografer tersebut yang bernama Bobby (Agoye Mahendra). Bobby bilang kalau ia tidak bermaksud memfoto Cindy, tapi Cindy tidak terima

programme.title: Buku Harian Monalisa
programme.desc: Menceritakan tentang kehidupan seorang gadis bernama Monalisa (Azella Alhamid). Monalisa tinggal di rumahnya yang besar dan mewah bersama asisten rumah tangganya. Meski demikian, Monalisa sering menjadi korban bully di kampusnya. Pada suatu hari, Monalisa dikurung di dalam kamar mandi oleh teman-teman kuliahnya. Beruntung Aldo (Julian Jacob), temannya membantunya.Aldo mendobrak pintu kamar mandi hingga Monalisa akhirnya bisa keluar. Setelah itu, Monalisa langsung memeluk Aldo dengan erat. Tidak hanya itu, Aldo pun sering menyelamatkan Monalisa yang kerap menjadi bulan-bulanan di kampusnya karena penampilannya yang culun.

programme.desc: Sekelompok mahasiswa menghabiskan malam di sebuah rumah besar tua yang menyeramkan, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa seorang penguntit yang mengerikan sedang mengawasi setiap gerakan mereka saat ia memulai rencana untuk mengambil alih artefak penduduk asli Amerika kuno yang ada di dalamnya.

programme.title: The Lurking Fear
programme.desc: Ketika kru TV merekam sebuah reality show di sebuah rumah sakit jiwa yang terbengkalai, mereka bertemu dengan gerombolan iblis, yang menyebabkan pertarungan berdarah untuk bertahan hidup.

programme.title: Chosen
programme.desc: Seorang pengacara muda yang sederhana memimpin sebuah perang melawan pasukan Nazi menjelang akhir dari Perang Dunia II.

programme.title: American Rider
programme.desc: Dua pengendara sepeda motor berangkat dari LA menuju New Orleans melalui daerah terbuka dan padang gurun, dan di sepanjang jalan mereka bertemu dengan seorang pria yang menjembatani kesenjangan budaya tandingan yang sebelumnya tidak mereka ketahui.

programme.title: American Rider

Kini, giliran Petugas dan seorang ibu tunggal, Dana Cypress, untuk memecahkan kasus pembunuhan di mana semua orang, hidup atau mati, menjadi tersangka.

programme.desc: Pada hari-hari terakhir Perang Dunia Pertama, sekelompok tentara AS dikirim ke belakang garis musuh untuk menyelamatkan sebuah peleton yang tersesat.

programme.desc: Angkatan Laut Jerman dan kapal-kapal U-Boat yang tersisa bergabung untuk satu misi terakhir guna menyerang Amerika Serikat.

Namun, sebuah celah dalam rencana mereka yang dianggap sempurna memecah belah kelompok tersebut, yang berpotensi berujung pada situasi yang mematikan.

programme.title: Decoding Animal Culture, Ep 1
programme.desc: Sebagaimana manusia, hewan juga saling berbagi pengetahuan dan tradisi yang mereka pelajari satu sama lain, lalu mewariskannya dari generasi ke generasi. Untuk pertama kalinya, para ilmuwan serta pakar ekologi dan etologi sepakat bahwa budaya hewan merupakan bentuk pewarisan kedua selain genetika. Dalam serial dokumenter tiga bagian ini, kita akan mengamati lebih dekat berbagai perilaku menakjubkan di alam liar dan menemukan betapa luasnya budaya yang berkembang di berbagai populasi hewan. Dokumenter ini mengungkap beragam keterampilan dan kebiasaan yang menyatukan individu-individu dalam kelompok mereka. Saatnya menjelajahi kehidupan sosial hewan di seluruh dunia dengan sudut pandang baru, menyingkap kemampuan luar biasa dan kekayaan budaya yang selama ini luput dari perhatian kita. Saksikan bagaimana ternyata manusia memiliki lebih banyak kesamaan dengan dunia hewan daripada yang kita bayangkan.

Upin dan Ipin bersekolah di Tadika Mesra yang terletak dalam kawasan kampung, di mana mereka berteman dengan banyak teman yang bermacam-macam tingkah lakunya, seperti Mei Mei yang imut dan cerdas, Jarjit Singh yang gemar membuat humor dan membuat pantun, Ehsan yang cerewet dan suka makan, Fizi yang sangat pede tetapi suka mengejek orang lain, dan Mail yang pintar jualan dan berhitung, suka melamun dan mengantuk karena ia berjualan ayam semalaman. Kampung Durian Runtuh juga didatangi oleh seorang gadis bernama Susanti yang merupakan pindahan dari Jakarta, Indonesia.

programme.title: Hiyokko
programme.desc: Hiyokko mengisahkan Mineko Yatabe, gadis ceria dari sebuah desa pertanian di Prefektur Ibaraki pada masa pertumbuhan ekonomi Jepang tahun 1960-an. Ketika ayahnya menghilang saat bekerja di Tokyo, Mineko memutuskan merantau ke ibu kota untuk mencarinya sekaligus membantu perekonomian keluarga. Selama perjalanannya, ia bekerja di pabrik, menjalin persahabatan baru, dan menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan di kota besar. Dengan semangat pantang menyerah, Mineko belajar tentang arti keluarga, persahabatan, kerja keras, dan harapan di tengah perubahan zaman.

programme.desc: Hiyokko mengisahkan Mineko Yatabe, gadis ceria dari sebuah desa pertanian di Prefektur Ibaraki pada masa pertumbuhan ekonomi Jepang tahun 1960-an. Ketika ayahnya menghilang saat bekerja di Tokyo, Mineko memutuskan merantau ke ibu kota untuk mencarinya sekaligus membantu perekonomian keluarga. Selama perjalanannya, ia bekerja di pabrik, menjalin persahabatan baru, dan menghadapi berbagai tantangan kehidupan di kota besar. Dengan semangat pantang menyerah, Mineko belajar tentang arti keluarga, persahabatan, kerja keras, dan harapan di tengah perubahan zaman.

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 1

programme.title: Moby Dick, Pt 2
programme.desc: Kapten Ahab, diperankan oleh pemenang Academy Award, William Hurt (The Incredible Hulk, Into the Wild), pergi berburu paus putih besar—yang dalam pertemuan sebelumnya telah membuatnya kehilangan kaki kanan bawahnya. Kini Ahab ingin membalas dendam, membawa kru ke laut, termasuk perwira pertama Starbuck (nominasi Academy Award, Ethan Hawke - Training Day, Boyhood) dan perwira kedua Stubb (Eddie Marsan - Sherlock Holmes), untuk mencari "Moby Dick".

programme.title: Heartman: Rock And Love

programme.title: Worst Woman (tvN Movies)

programme.title: Project Wolf Hunting

programme.desc: Upaya bunuh diri seorang pria yang gagal membuatnya dapat melihat hantu, yang kemudian terus mengikutinya ke mana pun. Kini terserah padanya untuk memenuhi keinginan mereka agar mereka pergi.

programme.title: Rebound (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Seorang pelatih basket pemula memimpin enam pemain tak berpengalaman untuk bertanding selama delapan hari berturut-turut dan mengubah hal yang mustahil menjadi mungkin.

programme.title: Unforgettable (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Orang-orang mengenang kisah cinta pertama mereka sambil mendengarkan kisah cinta di radio. Selama siaran langsung, seorang DJ radio menerima surat yang berisi kisah-kisah dari sebuah desa nelayan 23 tahun yang lalu.

programme.title: Hi-Five (tvN Movies)
programme.desc: Lima orang biasa memperoleh kekuatan super setelah menerima transplantasi organ dari seseorang yang sebelumnya memiliki kemampuan luar biasa. Kini mereka harus bersatu melawan seorang manusia yang juga mendapatkan kekuatannya melalui transplantasi organ dan berambisi merebut kekuatan mereka.

programme.title: Single In Seoul
programme.desc: Yeong-Ho adalah seorang pemengaruh terkenal yang mengagungkan kehidupan lajang. Hyeon-Jin adalah seorang editor yang sangat ingin menemukan pasangan. Keduanya bertemu saat bekerja bersama untuk sebuah buku.

programme.title: The Bad Guys: Reign Of Chaos
Second Sister
programme.desc: Setelah adiknya bunuh diri akibat fitnah dan komentar jahat di dunia maya, So-eun bersama detektif Jun-kyung mengungkap kebenaran di balik kasus yang melibatkan akun-akun anonim.

programme.title: Inspiring Indonesia
programme.desc: The show highlights inspiring people -individuals who through their actions, professions, or values make a positive impact in their communities.

programme.title: Solusi
programme.desc: U-Channel merupakan stasiun televisi religi yang menghadirkan berbagai program dan informasi bagi umat Kristiani.

programme.title: Bhoot Returns
programme.desc: Nimmi menemukan sebuah boneka dan melibatkan seseorang bernama 'Shabbu' dalam semua aktivitasnya. Keluarga tersebut mengira boneka baru Nimmi adalah Shabbu, tetapi terkejut ketika Nimmi menunjuk ke sebuah tempat kosong dan memperkenalkan teman tak kasatmatanya sebagai Shabbu.

programme.title: Terikat Janji
programme.desc: kisah cinta yang rumit, penuh intrik, dan pengkhianatan yang mengguncang, Terikat Janji

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang dua bersaudara, Andin (kakak) dan Elsa (adik). Tanpa mereka sadari mencintai pria yang sama, Nino. Hubungan mereka yang buruk menjadi lebih buruk ketika Elsa tahu bahwa Nino akan menikahi Andin. Pernikahan Nino dan Andin mendapat dukungan sang ayah, namun ditentang oleh sang ibu.

programme.title: Terbaik Itu Kamu
programme.desc: Satu pengkhianatan mengubah hidup selamanya, 5 tahun mendekam di penjara. Sekarang dia kembali dengan identitas baru, namun kebenaran tak mudah digenggam.

programme.title: Liontin
programme.desc: Manda dan Indy adalah kakak beradik yang saling menyayangi. Ibu mereka, Rianty, meninggal saat melahirkan Indy. She finds herself missing the company of her fellow Persimmon fan Huckleberry, and thinks up a great way to get him to visit. She invites Huck to co-write a story with her to submit to an online mystery magazine.. Huck eagerly accepts and comes for a visit.

programme.sub-title: Battle of the Builders / Frozen Fest Frenzy
programme.desc: Jett arrives in rainy London and brings a teddy bear to Cecily. They give the bear an umbrella and take him out to play. The wind lifts the bear away and he flies over the city and falls into a crowd of people with umbrellas. Jerome comes to lead the crowd in a dance number that ends with the bear being revealed and reunited with Cecily.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: Eraserhead [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Henry (John Nance) resides alone in a bleak apartment surrounded by industrial gloom. When he discovers that an earlier fling with Mary X (Charlotte Stewart) left her pregnant, he marries the expectant mother and has her move in with him. Things take a decidedly strange turn when the couple's baby turns out to be a bizarre lizard-like creature that won't stop wailing. Other characters, including a disfigured lady who lives inside a radiator, inhabit the building and add to Henry's troubles.

programme.title: Chopping Mall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight teenagers are trapped after hours in a high-tech shopping mall and pursued by three murderous security robots out of control.

programme.title: Swarmed
programme.desc: The residents of a small town find themselves battling a swarm of hornets that have been sprayed by a super pesticide.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: Manos: The Hands Of Fate
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries to elevate the material by hosting Manos as if it were an episode of Masterpiece Theater.

programme.title: Long Weekend
programme.desc: Peter (John Hargreaves) and Marcia (Briony Behets), a bitter married couple teetering on the edge of divorce, take a camping trip to heal the rift between them. As the weekend progresses, the selfish pair engage in reckless behavior that demonstrates an increasing disrespect for their natural surroundings. When Peter and Marcia become the targets of a series of inexplicable animal attacks, it becomes clear that an angry Mother Nature has come to exact her revenge.

programme.title: Fade To Black [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A shy, lonely film buff embarks on a killing spree against those who browbeat and betray him, all the while stalking his idol, a Marilyn Monroe lookalike.

programme.title: Living Dark: The Story of Ted the Caver
programme.desc: Two estranged brothers become obsessed with gaining access to an unexplored cave, despite the horrors they encounter during their excavation.

programme.title: Spiders 2
programme.desc: Alexandra (Stephanie Niznik) and Jason (Greg Cromer) are a married couple whose yacht fails to withstand a storm at sea. They're saved from the stormy waters by Capt. Bigelow (Daniel Quinn) and his crew, who man a cargo ship. Jason is heavily drugged by the ship's doctor, Gerbac (Richard Moll), and realizes something is amiss when he comes across corpses. Meanwhile, Gerbac is working on a dangerous scientific experiment using spider eggs, which he hopes to implant in Jason's body.

programme.title: Hush (2016) [B&W Shush Cut] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A deaf and mute writer who retreated into the woods to live a solitary life must fight for her life in silence when a masked killer appears at her window.

programme.title: A Fantastic Fear Of Everything [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A crime novelist whose research on Victorian serial killers has turned him into a paranoid wreck must confront his worst fears when a film executive takes a sudden interest in his movie script.

programme.title: Megaboa
programme.desc: On a trip to Colombia, a group of college students heads into the rainforest to look for cave drawings. Instead, they find a 50-foot boa constrictor.

programme.title: The Exorcist III: Legion (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Police Lt. Kinderman (George C. Scott) notices similarities between his current murder investigation and the methods used by the Gemini killer (Brad Dourif) who was executed 15 years before. He soon discovers a hospitalized mental patient (Jason Miller) claiming to be the dead serial killer, but who looks uncannily like a priest Kinderman knew who died during an exorcism. As more bodies are found, Kinderman looks for connections between the two supposedly dead men.

programme.title: Octopus
programme.desc: A Russian sub is sunk while en route to Havana. The hold is breached and barrels full of some mysterious substance tumble out. Later, reports of a killer octopus surface.

programme.title: Hell Night
programme.desc: Four college pledges are forced to spend the night in a deserted old mansion, where they are stalked by the monstrous survivor of a family massacre years earlier.

programme.title: Body Bags [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A creepy-looking coroner (John Carpenter) introduces three different horror tales involving his current work which are cadavers in "body bags."

programme.title: Flight 666
programme.desc: Passengers on an international flight are attacked by unseen forces. As they fight to stay alive, they realize who is controlling the attacks.

programme.title: The Pit
programme.desc: A solitary and strange preteen boy wreaks vengeance on his harassers when he makes a disturbing discovery in the depths of a forest.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: A Bucket Of Blood
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira tries her hand at being an artist in a variety of mediums. Also, Breather presents the Mistress of the Dark with The Publisher's Wet T-Shirt Contest Award.

programme.title: Shark Attack 3: Megalodon
programme.desc: In the third installment of the "Shark Attack" saga, marine researchers make a startling discovery: the most menacing beast that ever ruled these waters is still alive.

programme.title: House of Bones
programme.desc: A team of TV ghost hunters travel to investigate a haunted house surrounded by rumors. Upon their arrival, they find a foreboding house with a mind of its own. With Corin Nemec ("Stargate SG-1") and Charisma Carpenter ("Angel").

programme.title: Alligator II: The Mutation
programme.desc: A police detective (Joseph Bologna) teams up with a Cajun hunter (Richard Lynch) to find a giant killer-reptile in the city sewers.

programme.title: Alligator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A baby alligator is flushed down a Chicago toilet and survives by eating discarded laboratory rats injected with growth hormones.

programme.title: House (1985) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Apollo 18
programme.desc: Apollo 17 was the last U.S.-sponsored lunar voyage -- or was it? Hours of found footage, classified for decades, point to a subsequent moon mission -- Apollo 18 -- that ended very badly. Astronauts John Grey (Ryan Robbins), Nathan Walker (Lloyd Owen) and Benjamin Anderson (Warren Christie), on a mission to install radar scanners, discover a Soviet space capsule nearby. The men also discover a dead cosmonaut, and unfortunately for them, learn how he died.

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

He escapes from the mental institution and returns to his old haunt, an amusement park with an attraction called "Dark Ride." programme.title: Jeffrey
programme.desc: Jeffrey (Steven Weber), a gay man living in New York City with an overwhelming fear of contracting AIDS, concludes that being celibate is the only option to protect himself. As fate would have it, shortly after his declaration of a sex-free existence, he meets the handsome Steve Howard (Michael T. Weiss), his dream man -- except for his HIV-positive status. Facing this dilemma, Jeffrey turns to his best friend (Patrick Stewart) and an outrageous priest (Nathan Lane) for guidance.

programme.title: The Texas Chainsaw Massacre Part 2
programme.desc: Chainsaw-wielding maniac Leatherface (Bill Johnson) is up to his cannibalistic ways once again, along with the rest of his twisted clan, including the equally disturbed Chop-Top (Bill Moseley). This time, the masked killer has set his sights on pretty disc jockey Vanita Stretch Brock (Caroline Williams), who teams up with Texas lawman Lefty Enright (Dennis Hopper) to battle the psychopath and his family deep within their lair, a macabre abandoned amusement park.

programme.desc: Megan (Natasha Lyonne) considers herself a typical American girl. She excels in school and cheerleading, and she has a handsome football-playing boyfriend, even though she isn't that crazy about him. So she's stunned when her parents decide she's gay and send her to True Directions, a boot camp meant to alter her sexual orientation. While there, Megan meets a rebellious and unashamed teen lesbian, Graham (Clea DuVall). Though Megan still feels confused, she starts to have feelings for Graham.

programme.desc: As her wedding to Thomas approaches, Michelle hires Hannah to oversee the newly-built Evergreen museum, which includes a storytelling project interviewing the citizens of Evergreen (think StoryCorps). Hannah sees this as an opportunity...

programme.title: Christmas Everlasting
programme.desc: Christmas is fast approaching and years of long workdays employed at New York's top corporate law firm are about to pay off now that Lucy Toomey will be made partner after the New Year. However, when her older sister with special needs, Alice, unexpectedly passes away, Lucy dreads returning back to Nilson's Bay, Wisconsin to handle her sister's estate.

programme.title: Catch a Christmas Star
programme.desc: Just as her latest Christmas album is being released, famous singer Nikki Crandon is reunited with her high school sweetheart and happily starts to believe they may be able to rekindle what they had in the past. However, problems arise in the form of pressure from her record company, an old boyfriend and the paparazzi. Will Nikki be able to overcome the many obstacles to finally be with the only man she has ever really loved?

programme.title: Christmas Sail
programme.desc: When single mom LIZ DARLING finds out that her estranged father has been injured in an accident, she has to go back to the town she grew up in, the picturesque town of Portside, in the Pacific Northwest. It's her first Christmas back in...

programme.title: Enchanted Christmas
programme.desc: Interior designer Laura returns to Utah to spearhead the renovation of an old hotel in time for the annual Christmas Eve show run by Ricardo, her ex-boyfriend and dance partner. When Laura steps in to dance in the finale with Ricardo, she is pulled between her job, her family, and her reawakened feelings for Ricardo. Stars Alexa PenaVega, Carlos PenaVega.

programme.title: Cancel Christmas
programme.desc: Santa Claus discovers children have become too greedy and must prove otherwise if he doesn't want his favorite holiday canceled. His mission is to teach two incorrigible children the importance of charity. Enlisting their help to aid a handicapped boy inspires the magic of the holiday season, and the children's joy in giving ensures Christmas is going to be better than ever this year. Stars Judd Nelson and Natalie Brown.

programme.title: A Nutcracker Christmas
programme.desc: A rising ballet star is ready to take the stage in her dream role when she receives the shocking news that her sister has died. Years later, she has vowed never to dance again, but a chance encounter with an old flame may change her mind.

programme.title: The Santa Suit
programme.desc: A corporate bigwig (Kevin Sorbo) learns valuable lessons when Santa Claus transforms him into his look-alike.

programme.title: Finding Father Christmas
programme.desc: Three days before Christmas, a woman who has never known her father receives a clue concerning his whereabouts. She follows the trail to a beautiful New England town where she meets a handsome young man willing to help with the search.

programme.title: Christmas in Conway
programme.desc: Hoping it will be the perfect Christmas present for his wife (Mary-Louise Parker), a man (Andy Garcia) plans to construct a Ferris wheel in his backyard.

programme.title: The Blackwater Lightship
programme.desc: Based on the novel by Colm Toibin, The Blackwater Lightship tells the compelling story of reconciliation between three generations of women whose relations have been marked by decades of misunderstandings.

programme.title: So You Said Yes
programme.desc: The owner (Kellie Martin) of a bridal shop falls in love with the son of her chief competitor, then must fend off the woman's attempts to sabotage the relationship.

programme.title: Karen Kingsbury's The Bridge Part 2
programme.desc: Based on Karen Kingsbury's bestselling novel, The Bridge, Molly and Ryan, college students from two different worlds, fell in love at Belmont University their freshman year. After unknowingly being manipulated to break up by Molly's controlling, media mogul father, they are reunited seven years later to save the bookstore that changed their lives. Stars Wyatt Nash, Katie Findlay, Faith Ford and Ted McGinley.

programme.title: Merry Matrimony
programme.desc: Brie, an advertising executive, lands her dream assignment organizing the perfect Christmas wedding for a fashion magazine. If she succeeds, she could make partner at her firm. The only catch is that she unknowingly has been paired up witha high powered fashion photographer who also happens to be her estranged ex. Will they be able to pull off the campaign or will the past sabotage the project before it begins? Stars Jessica Lowndes and Christopher Russell.

programme.title: Fallen Angel
programme.desc: Reluctantly returning to his hometown, a man (Gary Sinise) reconnects with a young woman (Joely Richardson) he knew as a child.

programme.title: Ice Sculpture Christmas
programme.desc: After starting her first job at a country club restaurant, Callie - an aspiring chef - reconnects with her childhood friend David, whose wealthy family is a member of the club. When David enters Callie into the club's annual Christmas ice sculpting competition without her knowledge, she's forced to go head-to-head with her boss, Chef Gloria. Even though ice sculpting is cold work, sparks are ignited between Callie and David as they prepare for the competition as a team.

programme.title: Road to Christmas
programme.desc: Maggie Baker is the Head Producer of America's favorite televised Christmas Eve tradition: The Julia Wise Christmas Special. Â Tasked with producing the show's first live taping, Maggie finds herself working alongside the eldest son...

programme.title: Baked with Love: Holiday
programme.desc: Host Tamera Mowry-Housley greets ten family pairs of bakers at the holiday baking barn, where they first must prove themselves with pie, and then heat things up with some exquisite yule logs.

programme.title: One Christmas Eve
programme.desc: A series of mishaps disturbs the plans of a recently divorced mom (Anne Heche) for her two kids on their first Christmas without dad.

programme.title: USS Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmastime in Norfolk, Virginia. Maddie Johnson is a reporter for the Norfolk Register who grew up in a military family. Maddie, her sister Lieutenant Amelia Breslan, and her mother Elizabeth are about to embark on a holiday...

programme.title: A Christmas Duet
programme.desc: Well-loved music duo AVERIE DAVIS and JESSE COLLINS, famous for their duet "Wouldn't Be Christmas," haven't played together since they went their separate ways years ago. Averie gave up music and opened a beautiful lodge in a snowy...

programme.title: Christmas Encore
programme.desc: A struggling actress is cast in her last off Broadway show before giving up on her dream and moving home. However, she has second thoughts as she discovers a renewed passion for her craft. But when the historic theater where they...

programme.title: Not Since You
programme.desc: A romantic drama about a tight-knit group of college friends who graduated from NYU and reunite years later for a weekend wedding in Georgia.

programme.title: Authors Anonymous
programme.desc: When a dysfunctional group of unpublished writers accepts Hannah into their fold, the last thing they expect is her overnight success. Can these lovable misfits achieve their artistic dreams and avoid killing one another in the process?

programme.title: When Jeff Tried to Save the World
programme.desc: When Jeff, the manager of an old-school bowling alley, discovers the owner's plans to sell, he has to use the things around him, including a high school stoner, a perverted janitor, a 90-year-old bowling champion, a sassy kitchen worker, and the occasional drug-induced conversation with Pac-Man, to save it.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: Aftermath
programme.desc: After waking up in the middle of a forest with no memories, a young woman is targeted by mysterious strangers with a motive as unclear as her way back home.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: Zenith
programme.desc: A retro-futuristic thriller about two men in two time periods, whose search for the same grand conspiracy leads them to question their own humanity.

programme.title: Favorite Son
programme.desc: When David returns to his childhood hometown, he is still haunted by old secrets. David is the last one the town elders want near the young, troubled Ross, but David might be the only one who can save Ross from an evil haunting the town.

programme.title: Is It Just Me?
programme.desc: A socially shunned columnist finds his romantic match online, but messaging under the wrong account causes his sleazy roommate's picture to be forwarded, creating an identity mix-up.

programme.title: .357: Six Bullets for Revenge
programme.desc: On her wedding night, Jade wakes up to find her husband dead. She pawns her ring for a .357 Magnum - and plots her revenge. A Vietnam vet helps transform her into a stunning vigilante, with a bullet marked for each of the treacherous family.

programme.title: Valley Of The Queens: Planned Obsolescence
programme.desc: When a spiritual oracle confronts him about his mischievous time on Earth, Michael, an angel determined to get justice on his own terms, must save Black Americans from a dark future of planned obsolescence.

programme.title: Losing Sight of Shore
programme.desc: Dive deep into this awe-inspiring, incredible adventure following four brave women who set out to row across the Pacific Ocean.

programme.title: We Don't Deserve Dogs
programme.desc: A contemplative odyssey across our planet, looking at the simple and extraordinary ways that dogs influence our daily lives. People need dogs, and perhaps they need us, but what do humans do to deserve the unconditional love they provide?

programme.title: Halloween at Aunt Ethel's
programme.desc: Everyone in town knows the story of Old Aunt Ethel. It's said she makes Halloween candy and pumpkin pie out of the kids that trick-or-treat at her house. This Halloween, the neighborhood teens are going to find out the truth.

programme.title: Savageland
programme.desc: When a small town near the Arizona/Mexico border is wiped out overnight, suspicion falls on an illegal immigrant who is the lone survivor...

programme.title: Chambers Gate
programme.desc: A government official wants to stop crime in his city and make it a safer place for citizens. However, when he is accused of murder it leads to events he never could foresee.

programme.title: A Green Story
programme.desc: Greek emigrant Van Vlahakis arrives in America with only $22 in his pocket but later goes on to found a multimillion dollar company called Earth Friendly Products.

programme.title: Murder Loves Killers Too
programme.desc: A deranged man, whose version of sex is murdering people, hunts after a group of sexy teenagers.

programme.title: Exegesis Lovecraft
programme.desc: A documentary following a filmmaker as he traces the life of H.P. Lovecraft, from woodland cemeteries in Rhode Island to the docks of New York and the streets of Quebec City. A film that proves that the truth is weirder than fiction.

programme.title: Created Equal: Clarence Thomas in His Own Words
programme.desc: Clarence Thomas tells his dramatic life story, rising from poverty in the segregated South to the Supreme Court. The producers had unprecedented access, interviewing Justice Thomas and his wife for over 30 hours.

programme.title: Lynch: A History
programme.desc: Lynch: A History is a kaleidoscopic look at Marshawn Lynch's use of silence as a form of protest. Culling 700 clips and placing them in radical juxtaposition, the film is a powerful parable about American sports media and racial oppression.

programme.title: The Exquisite Corpse Project
programme.desc: A first-of-its-kind comedy about five writers who are challenged to each write fifteen minutes of a movie, after having read only the previous five pages of the script.

programme.title: Princes of the Yen
programme.desc: Princes of the Yen reveals how post-war Japanese society was transformed to suit the agenda of powerful interest groups, and how citizens were kept entirely in the dark about this. History is now repeating itself around the world.

programme.title: Bitter/Sweet
programme.desc: Brian, an American businessman, is sent to Thailand in search of local coffee plantations to purchase, but he ends up finding more than just coffee, and that the original purpose of the trip might not even be about coffee after all.

programme.title: High Strung Free Dance
programme.desc: A young choreographer casts a contemporary dancer and an innovative pianist in New York's most anticipated new Broadway show.

programme.title: Missing Pieces
programme.desc: A heartbroken man kidnaps two strangers in hopes they will fall in love.

programme.title: Summer Snow
programme.desc: Hallie is a small girl with a huge heart. Unfortunately, her creative ways of helping people often leave her father, Dan, with a mess to clean up.

programme.title: Heaven's Messenger
programme.desc: A doctor tries to solve the mystery of a man with no name, multiple personalities, and burns on his hands. Who is he and what happened to him?

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: In Flight
programme.desc: The night before Claire Reynolds' trip to Paris, she catches the eye of a mysterious, handsome stranger. That's the last thing she remembers before waking up on a plane with no recollection of what happened after that.

programme.title: Desert Fiends
programme.desc: Six friends on their way to a concert break down in the middle of nowhere and encounter a deranged family that lives in the desert killing anyone they come across.

programme.title: From Embers
programme.desc: After the tragic loss of her husband Ron, Lily finds herself navigating a challenging new reality with her son Kevin. As they settle into a modest apartment, Lily's encounter with their neighbor Marty brings up an unexpected revelation about Ron's suspicious death. Marty is an alcoholic and his passion for music is only surpassed by his love for his daughter Chloe. When Lily delves deeper into the mystery surrounding Ron's demise, she forms a bond with his co-worker Angela.

programme.title: Wind and Bone
programme.desc: A woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural West Virginia, where they soon encounter the Wendigo.

programme.title: Lilies Not For Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Paradox Effect
programme.desc: estranged from her daughter because of a past life of drug-abuse, Karina is taking all the steps she can towards being the mother she needs to be. One night Karina hears the discharge of a muted weapon and a body breaking through heavy glass. Looking up, she locks eyes with the man who pulled the trigger and she is captured. The mastermind of it all is crime lord Silvio and his vicious gangsters who forces Karina and Covek, a deadly killer threatened by him, to go on a journey against time.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: Gus and July save Lorena from Blue Duck, but at a deadly cost. Jake runs with a bad crowd and pays the price. July accepts that his wife has left him and stays on at Clara's with his newborn son.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove
programme.desc: The cattle drive reaches Nebraska, where Gus and Clara reunite. Drought and Indian attacks take their toll as the drive reaches Montana, and Gus is wounded. Call honors his best friend's request.

programme.title: Jesus Of Nazareth
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: Jesus Of Nazareth
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: Inhabitants
programme.desc: Going against the wishes of their family members, Olivia and her boyfriend, Francis, move to California for an exciting new life. However, when Francis starts to sleepwalk and experience night terrors, the couple soon discover they're being haunted by a ghost that wants to punish them for their sins.

programme.title: Great White Summer
programme.desc: From the peaks of Cape Cod's surfing waves to the murky depths below, trouble runs deep on this beloved New England seashore after the first fatal shark attack in eighty years upends the community. With the predator population on the rise, and increasing encounters placing lives and livelihoods in peril, Great White Summer chronicles a season of struggle as people demand action, priorities are questioned, personal allegiances shift, and growing suspicion clouds the waters.

programme.title: Fittest on Earth: Final Showdown in Madtown
programme.desc: A diverse group of elite male and female athletes competes for the coveted title of Fittest on Earth in the 2023 CrossFit Games.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: The Little Shop of Horrors
programme.desc: A clumsy young man nurtures a plant and discovers that it's carnivorous, forcing him to kill to feed it.

programme.title: Inland Empire
programme.desc: Nikki (Laura Dern), an actress, takes on a role in a new film, and because her husband (Peter J. Lucas) is very jealous, her co-star Devon (Justin Theroux) gets a warning not to make any romantic overtures -- especially since the characters they play are having an affair. Both actors learn that the project is a remake of an unfinished film in which the stars were murdered.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel to the Exorcist
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Perrier's Bounty
programme.desc: A petty crook (Cillian Murphy), his ailing father (Jim Broadbent) and a pretty neighbor go on the run from an Irish mobster's (Brendan Gleeson) goons.

programme.title: The General
programme.desc: One of the most revered comedies of the silent era, this film finds hapless Southern railroad engineer Johnny Gray (Buster Keaton) facing off against Union soldiers during the American Civil War. When Johnny's fiancée, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack), is accidentally taken away while on a train stolen by Northern forces, Gray pursues the soldiers, using various modes of transportation in comic action scenes that highlight Keaton's boundless wit and dexterity.

programme.title: Fast Vengeance
programme.desc: Determined to find those responsible for his brother's death, a man infiltrates the dangerous and high-stakes world of underground motorcycle racing.

programme.title: Blind Horizon
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Arlington Road
programme.desc: Widowed when his FBI agent wife is killed by an extremist group, college professor Michael Faraday (Jeff Bridges) becomes obsessed with the culture of these groups -- especially when his new all-American neighbors, Oliver (Tim Robbins) and Cheryl Lang (Joan Cusack), start acting suspiciously. With each twist, the mystery deepens and questions loom whether Faraday is consumed by fear and driven by paranoia, or whether a lethal conspiracy has been born on Arlington Road.

programme.title: Shaolin Wooden Men
programme.desc: A fighter vows not to speak until he finds the masked man who killed his father.

programme.title: A Walk in the Woods
programme.desc: Travel writer Bill Bryson (Robert Redford) takes a long-lost old friend (Nick Nolte) for a hike along the Appalachian Trail, which stretches more than 2,000 miles from Georgia to Maine.

programme.title: Take Me Home Tonight
programme.desc: Recent MIT grad Matt Franklin (Topher Grace) should be well on his way to a successful career at a Fortune 500 company, but instead, he rebels against maturity by taking a job at a video store. Matt rethinks his position when his unrequited high-school crush, Tori (Teresa Palmer), walks in and invites him to an end-of-summer party. With the help of his twin sister (Anna Faris) and his best friend (Dan Fogler), Matt hatches a plan to change the course of his life.

programme.title: Animal Factory
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Sin City: A Dame to Kill For
programme.desc: The damaged denizens of Sin City return for another round of stories from the mind of Frank Miller. In "Just Another Saturday Night," Marv (Mickey Rourke) struggles to recall a nasty run-in with some frat boys. In "A Dame to Kill For," Dwight McCarthy (Josh Brolin) forsakes his battle with his inner demons to help Ava Lord (Eva Green), the woman of his dreams and nightmares. In "Nancy's Last Dance," Nancy Callahan (Jessica Alba), mad with grief and rage over Hartigan's death, vows revenge.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: When the LAPD kills several members of the South Central gang Street Thunder, the remaining members avenge themselves by way of a bloody war waged against cops and citizens alike. Caught in the crossfire is Lt. Ethan Bishop (Austin Stoker), who's managing a skeleton crew at the local and soon-to-be-closed police precinct. As the gang members close in, Bishop forms an unlikely alliance with a group of prisoners in order to defend the station and the lives of everyone in it.

programme.title: Then Came You
programme.desc: A terminally ill teenager and a 19-year-old hypochondriac help each other achieve their dreams and face their fears.

programme.title: Poolhall Junkies
programme.desc: A billiards player ends his conflicted friendship with a con man who taught him how to play the game.

programme.title: The Long Good Friday
programme.desc: In the late 1970s, Cockney crime boss Harold Shand (Bob Hoskins), a gangster trying to become a legitimate property mogul, has big plans to get the American Mafia to bankroll his transformation of a derelict area of London into the possible venue for future Olympic Games. However, a series of bombings targets his empire on the very weekend the Americans are in town. Shand is convinced there is a traitor in his organization, and sets out to eliminate the rat in typically ruthless fashion.

programme.title: Bullet in the Head
programme.desc: Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) land in the 1960s Vietnam.

programme.title: The Lady Vanishes
programme.desc: In the years before World War II, zany heiress Amanda Kelly (Cybill Shepherd) travels by train to Switzerland. While passing through Germany, she meets a sweet elderly lady, Miss Froy (Angela Lansbury), who suddenly vanishes. Distraught, Amanda questions her fellow passengers who claim that the woman was never there. Unsure if it's all in her mind or if there's a more sinister plot afoot, Amanda teams up with photographer Robert Condon (Elliott Gould) to discover the truth.

programme.title: Bright Young Things
programme.desc: During the 1930s in England, a group of young socialites dominate the national gossip with extravagant and outlandish antics. Among the group is the aspiring novelist Adam Fenwick-Symes, who is attempting to raise enough money to marry fellow member Nina Blount. However, after customs officials confiscate his first manuscript, Fenwick-Symes must recover from the financial setback and figure out new ways to earn money for a wedding.

programme.title: Piranha
programme.desc: A government tank containing genetically engineered piranha is unwittingly emptied into a river that flows past a resort area.

programme.title: Buena Vista Social Club
programme.desc: This documentary by lauded German filmmaker Wim Wenders follows renowned guitarist Ry Cooder and his son, Joachim, as they travel to Cuba and assemble a group of the country's finest musicians to record an album. Among the artists included in the project are singer Ibrahim Ferrer and pianist Rubén González, who are both interviewed and featured in studio footage. Eventually the ensemble travels to the United States to perform in front of rapt audiences.

programme.title: Winter Kills
programme.desc: Inspired by the conspiracy theories surrounding John F. Kennedy's assassination, this comic thriller follows Nick Kegan (Jeff Bridges), the younger brother of a U.S. president killed 19 years earlier. After finding a man claiming to be his brother's second assassin, Nick begins an intricate investigation into the secrets behind the murder. But Nick runs into trouble when his controlling father (John Huston) tries to keep him from uncovering the truth.

programme.title: Bad Moon
programme.desc: Ted (Michael Paré) is working in Nepal when he and his girlfriend are attacked by a mysterious creature. Ted, though brutally maimed, survives, but his girlfriend is not so lucky. To help his recovery, Ted moves close to his sister, Janet (Mariel Hemingway), and her son, Brett (Mason Gamble), but soon realizes he was attacked by a werewolf. Ted is helpless to stop his transformation and only Brett's German shepherd, Thor, is able to see that Ted is a danger to everyone around him.

programme.title: Battle Beyond the Stars
programme.desc: Shad of Akir (Richard Thomas) recruits a space cowboy (George Peppard) and other warriors to defend his planet from a barbarian's army.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahiro must pay four years of overdue fees or lose their membership in their assassin guild. They take part-time jobs, but find themselves in the middle of an armed robbery and being hunted by other assassins.

programme.title: Furie
programme.desc: A former gang leader battles human traffickers to save her kidnapped daughter.

programme.title: The Villainess
programme.desc: Honed from childhood to be an elite assassin, Sook-hee embarks on a rampage of violence and revenge to finally earn her freedom and escape her past.

programme.title: The Legend of Tomiris
programme.desc: The life story of Tomiris, the great queen of the steppe, who was destined to become a skillful warrior and unite the Scythian and Saka tribes.

programme.title: Baby Assassins
programme.desc: Two high school girls who are about to graduate also happen to be highly-skilled assassins. When the organization that employs them orders them to share a room, their relationship turns sour.

programme.title: Baby Assassins 2
programme.desc: Chisato and Mahiro must pay four years of overdue fees or lose their membership in their assassin guild. They take part-time jobs, but find themselves in the middle of an armed robbery and being hunted by other assassins.

programme.desc: A legendary demon hunter investigates the disappearance of young girls from a village.
